I don’t love abortion. Not by a long shot. But we can’t force women to have babies, pay for the birth, and then require them to go back to work at 1-2 weeks postpartum because we have zero infrastructure to support mothers, infants, and families. To be truly pro-life is to vote for a system in which our most vulnerable are truly cared for. Forcing people to have children without that support would mean babies starved, abused, and far worse. What else do we expect from unfit parents forced to be parents? If we think abortion is bad, imagine a world in which it’s fully grown and birthed humans. Any parent knows just how much goes into being a good one - what makes anyone think a person can be forced to actually care for a tender, needy child? And our adoption system is so incredibly broken, so that’s not a great option, either.
